clothing.title: Clothing Item
clothing.description: Represents a garment or fashion item in the catalog with pricing, images, and specifications.

id.description: Unique identifier of the clothing item

originalPrice.description: Previous or original retail price before discount

category.description: Catalog category (e.g., Abrigos, Camisas, Pantalones, Vestidos, Accesorios)

description.description: Detailed description of the garment and fit

materials.description: Composition and fabric details (e.g. 100% Lino Orgánico)

images.description: List of image URLs showcasing the clothing item

sizes.description: Available clothing sizes like XS, S, M, L, XL

colors.description: Available color names and hex codes

stockStatus.description: Inventory status: in_stock, low_stock, or out_of_stock

featured.description: Whether the piece is highlighted on the front lookbook gallery

tag.description: Special badge like NUEVO, EDICIÓN LIMITADA, o REBAJAS

catalogSettings.title: Catalog Settings
catalogSettings.description: General settings for the store catalog including store name, currency, and announcement message.

currency.description: Default currency code or symbol (e.g. USD, EUR, $)

contactWhatsApp.description: WhatsApp phone number for customer orders or inquiries

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last configuration update

/clothes/{clothId}.description: Collection of clothing items shown in the fashion lookbook gallery

/settings/{settingId}.description: Store configuration and global display preferences
